Description:
ALIASES:
　/eattaco, /taco
USAGE:
　/eattaco [subcommand]

→Eat a sizable taco.

>>Subcommands:
 　**motion**    Perform motion only.

Both text and motion will be displayed when no subcommand is specified.

USAGE:
　/devourtaco [subcommand]

→Continuously chow down on a sizable taco.

>>Subcommands:
 　**motion**    Perform motion only.

Both text and motion will be displayed when no subcommand is specified.
